trimmingSuggestions.description: The video could be trimmed by starting directly with the close-up of the tarp hole. Showing the entire tarp setup before revealing the hole doesn't add much to the narrative.
The segment where the Narrator struggles to locate the exact spot of the hole on the forest floor feels repetitive and could be shortened or removed entirely.

youtube_description:
On Memorial Day weekend camping outside of Bloomington Indiana; my hammock Gear Cat Cut 4 Season Cuben Fiber Tarp took a nasty hit from a falling limb. 

Please excuse the camera guy he wasn't familiar with this camera. I hope this information will help others that are interested in cuben fiber. The tear has not run, and will be easy to repair with cuben tape. Once I get the tape I'll make a follow-up video on how I did the repair. 

Thanks for watching. 

More info on hammock camping available at
www.hammockfoums.net
